source.label: mtgo.com decklists: Vintage Eternal Weekend: Mox Emerald

notes.text: Placings are from mtgo.com (its final ranking and Top 8 bracket); there was no written coverage. mtgo.com names no archetypes; archetype names are mtgtop8's.
Started 2021-11-26 17:00 PST (2021-11-27 01:00 UTC); the Top 8 was played on 2021-11-27 in both time zones.
Magic Online lists each printing of a card on its own line; copies of the same card are added together here.
Seeds are the seeding shown in mtgo.com's Top 8 bracket.
Main deck of 61 cards as registered on Magic Online (mtgtop8 also has 61); kept as listed.
